## Development Plan

### 1. Verify Claude Model Support in SAP AI Core Provider
**Priority: MODERATE | Effort: ~2h | Category: provider**

The Alexi provider layer uses SAP AI Core orchestration proxy. Current ORCHESTRATION_MODELS list includes:
- `anthropic--claude-3.7-sonnet`
- `anthropic--claude-4.5-haiku`
- `anthropic--claude-4.5-sonnet`
- `anthropic--claude-4.5-opus`
- `anthropic--claude-4.7-opus`

Research from Aider #5173 added these Claude models:
- `claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219`
- `claude-opus-4-1` / `claude-opus-4-1-20250805`
- `claude-opus-4-5` / `claude-opus-4-5-20251101`
- `claude-opus-4-6-20260205`
- `claude-opus-4-7-20260416`

**Analysis needed:**
1. Check if ORCHESTRATION_MODELS list needs new entries for dated variants
2. Verify SAP AI Core deployment supports new model IDs
3. Ensure temperature parameter is correctly handled for opus-4 models (Aider disabled deprecated temperature)
4. Update routing-config.example.json if needed
5. Add provider tests for new model ID routing

**Files to review:**
- `src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts` (ORCHESTRATION_MODELS constant, line ~1513)
- `src/providers/transform.ts` (temperature handling, line ~434)
- `src/providers/model-match.ts` (ANTHROPIC_MODELS constant, includes claude-opus-4)
- `routing-config.example.json` (model examples)
- `src/providers/__tests__/model-match.test.ts` (existing tests reference opus-4)

**Outcome:** Ensure Alexi supports latest Claude models as they become available in SAP AI Core, with correct parameter handling.
